title: Medalist
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Eleven-year-old Inori Yuitsuka dreams of being a world-class figure skater, though she is considered too old to start and her mother, burned by her older daughter's failed skating career, opposes it. Tsukasa Akeuraji, a former ice dancer about to give up skating, becomes her coach. Inori turns out to have great natural talent, and the two aim for Olympic gold.
life_message: Hard work, joy in what you love and an adult who believes in you can overturn what others say is too late.
